review: Implemented the actual two batched world-38 reviews at round 12 with two ex12-only abilities and one shared composition schema. Real owned roots, stones and bark enter conserved persistent escrow; paid rounds, interruption, cancellation and death preserve partial progress and actual materials without refunds or duplication. Crushing preserves nutrition, age and represented composition; reviewed previously unknown water composition is explicitly initialized to 50 percent, never free nutrients. Weather-driven drying and rewetting change actual mass, water ledger and future decay rate, with no age reset; unloaded food remains exposed. Reusable trays retain real components, qualified other members can use empty trays, and simultaneous contested loads retain the existing all-conflicts-rejected rule. Previously prepared food is an actual compatible input with retained provenance and reduced remaining work. Existing canonical meal feedback is reused unchanged instead of adding the redundant proposed reward or changing its frozen window. No mastery, stock or output is granted at installation. Generic ex11 escrow/profile implementation reuse is attributed; A abilities and historical preservation effects remain excluded. Eight targeted actual-kernel tests passed, covering actual eating, input conservation, failure/recovery/death, expiry cleanup, composition, second-person use, moisture and decay, A/B isolation and restore. Browser fixture passed and all six final screenshots were personally inspected: readable paid work, actual material counts and food, empty reusable tray, 12 percent dry food at 0.35 decay, and 15.2 percent rewetted food at 1.25 decay. Initial overlapping tool labels and stale fixture work events were corrected and recaptured. Fixtures are isolated from formal decisions and are not emergence evidence. Full handoff validation and exact twelve-round prefix reconstruction remain mandatory. Seed, resource baseline, incentive policy and committed history are unchanged; internal development tokens remain unobservable.
